ground_truth_notes: Synthetic mock report from the doc2_* batch — Phase 1 scoring is restricted to the report_metadata section. Genomic_Variant / other_molecular_biomarker / tested_biomarker umbrellas are emitted as empty placeholders to satisfy the always-emit-all-4-sections rule; they will be hand-labelled and scored in Phase 2/3.
Different layout from doc_* files — tables with biomarker grids, footer carries patient/case/physician on every page.

Two distinct diagnoses present in the source: 'Lobular carcinoma in situ (LCIS)' in header, 'Infiltrating moderately-differentiated mammary carcinoma' on page 4 — header is the clinical/referring diagnosis, page 4 is the pathological finding. Neither is part of report_metadata; both are out-of-scope for Phase 1 scoring.
'Ordered By' section header on page 1 has no value beneath it — physician name 'Dr. Wanda Nguyen' is only visible in the page footers. Extractor must check footer for doc2_* templates.
Vendor name absent — no vendor masthead or branding visible AND no product marker. Vendor_Name = null.
No practice / institution name visible anywhere in the report.
Case Number 4751 serves as the accession identifier; no separate MRN. Per strict MRN rule, Patient_MRN = null. (Schema v2 has no Accession_Number field in report_metadata.)

Test_Name 'Molecular profiling (multi-biomarker panel)' is a paraphrase of the report's panel description (no single literal phrase in the document); for Phase 1 this is acceptable as a normalized Test_Name. Pipeline may emit a slightly different verbatim phrase — accept either as a match during scoring with a fuzzy comparator.
